sources.citation: Scorza, David. 1985. A sketch of Au morphology and syntax. Papers in New Guinea Linguistics 22 (Pacific Linguistics A-63), 215-273.
sources.note: Bragat only as no. 22 in the Torricelli family tree (p.263); sec. 6.3 'General Torricelli Phylum characteristics' (p.264) repeats Laycock's segmental summary, no stress statement. (Au itself: stress predictable, normally first syllable -- not about Bragat.)

sources.citation: Laycock, Donald C. 1975. The Torricelli Phylum. In S. A. Wurm (ed.), New Guinea area languages and language study 1, 767-780. Pacific Linguistics C-38.
sources.note: Phylum-level segmental summary only (p.769: three positions of articulation, usually no voicing contrast, 5-8 vowels, many fricatives); nothing on stress; Bragat appears only in the checklist.
